dataList.content:
The Lake...
湖水……
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
When I look into its waters... I see my shimmering reflection.
每当我眺望湖水之时，总会见到自己那起伏不定的倒影。

Maybe I'm just as refracted and twisted like my reflection in the water. It doesn't matter which Lake we're on... I always look so warped, so unstable...
无论大湖如何变化，水中倒映的我依然一如既往的扭曲……也许如此扭曲的姿态，才是我的本来面目……

I happened upon Ishmael's musings around the time we were on our way to the elusive Lobotomy Corp. Branch of the Great Lake. It had been a while since our last disastrous incident.
距上次那场灾难性事件一段时间后，在我们前往那位于大湖某处的脑叶公司支部的路上，我偶然听见以实玛利在自言自语。

Maybe my distorted reflections were just... me.
也许我于湖上映出的无数扭曲姿态……就是真正的我自己。

Even from a distance, it was evident that Ishmael was gazing down at her own reflection in the water.
纵使在远处，我也依旧能清楚地看见以实玛利眺望的方向。那是映于湖面上的，她自己的身姿。

I rested my wandering feet and decided to watch her for a moment.
我决定停下彷徨的脚步，也看看那副映于水上的身姿。

I... wanted to see what Ishmael was looking at. Together.
我……也想一起看看以实玛利所看到的东西。

My hands were... peeling... bleeding...
我的手……在渗血……

Saltwater seeped into my gaping wounds. It hurt so much. So, so much that I thought I might faint if I didn't let go...
海水渗入我开裂的伤口，那是如此的刺痛，仿佛若我不立刻放手，就会疼到晕厥……

But I couldn't.
但我不能放手。

What was I holding on to?
不想放手的又是什么呢。

Executive Manager, there is a matter that requires your attention! We are approaching our next coordinates.
执行经理！有件事需要您注意。我们在靠近下一个坐标。

<O-okay!>
<好、好的！>

I'll go see, too.
我也来看看。

Ishmael woke from her introspection and straightened herself. She strode toward us.
沉浸在思绪中的以实玛利似乎清醒了过来，向我们大步走来。

What's up ahead?
前方有什么？
dataList.place:
Cabins of Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 船舱

dataList.content:
The radar's caught something. We have visual on...
雷达捕捉到了什么。我们面前可以看到……

... A solitary ship.
……一艘孤船。

And it looks like we have 3 hours to kill before we're allowed to move on to the next Lake. Unless...
然后……这次的湖域需要我们待机三个小时。在去下一片湖域前，我们必须要等待三小时……

... the Executive Manager would authorize us to weather the Waves once more...
……但若执行经理能像上次那样，允许我们直面浪潮的话，可就不一定了。

<No, Outis.>
<不行，奥提斯。>

<The losses were worse than I anticipated... And remember what Ishmael said. We were extremely lucky the Waves that came for us was a relatively manageable one.>
<那么做的损失比我预想的要大得多……还有，别忘了以实玛利说过，那只不过是我们的运气特别好，碰上了可以突破的浪潮罢了。>

Yes, Executive Manager.
……遵从您的命令。

Thanks to Outis, who quickly abandoned the idea, the Sinners and I could observe this new vessel with somewhat lighter hearts.
幸亏奥提斯及时打消了这个念头，我和罪人们可以略微放松，去观察这艘新出现的船了。

Ah, what a relief. That doesn't look like a pirate ship. That's...
啊，幸好它看起来不像是海盗船。而像是……
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
OOOOOOOOOOOHHH!
哦哦哦哦哦！

LO! That is a Mini-Cruuuiise ship over yonder!
那边是一艘小型游轮吧？！

A veritable par-tay ship! A vessel of par-taying!
是开派对的船吧！是开派对的船吧！！

Even from this distance, I could see the colorful balloons and banners decorating the ship.
纵使从远处，我依旧能看到这艘船上挂满的五彩缤纷的气球和旗帜。

I! LOVE! TO! PARRR-TAY!
吾！非常非常！喜欢派对！

None shall be vexed, no matter how I frolic at a party! Naught will pay mind to how I leap and run and shout in there! What joy, is it not?!
在那里，大家都可以像吾一样大声喊叫、跑来跑去，而不用担心被斥责，多么令人高兴的事情啊！

Vergie... Go easy on the girl, why don'tcha...?
维吉……你到底把她折磨成什么样了啊……

But... mmm. I'm sure they sell local delicacies there, too... Liquor... Treats not found anywhere else in the City...
啊啊……这种地方通常会提供特色美食……还有酒……那是只能在那里才能品尝到的……十分珍贵的佳肴……

Rodya and Don Quixote both shot twinkling glances in my direction, then at Vergilius. Then back at me.
罗佳和堂吉诃德同时用水汪汪的大眼睛看向我和维吉里乌斯。

Vergilius shrugged. Whatever we decided to do here was none of his business.
维吉里乌斯耸了耸肩，仿佛我们所做的一切与他无关。

<... Well... Maybe they can tell us something about the nearby Lobotomy Corp. Branch. Or maybe they know something about the LCCB Agents...?>
<说不定那里的人，会知道有关附近的脑叶公司支部的信息……或者是关于LCCB队员们的消息呢？>

Hmm, hmhm~ Hm hm~
哼，哼哼~哼哼~

Don Quixote was rhythmically swaying her shoulders... Maybe she's trying to imitate the Marlin Dance she glimpsed back at the Club.
堂吉诃德正在按节奏舞动肩膀……也许她在尝试跳在会所里看到的马林鱼舞。

Heigh-ho!!! Allow me to ask thee and thy fine company a few questions!!
嘿，那边的诸位！！！吾有些事情想问一下！！

The faintly blaring music was the only response from the ship.
然而除了微弱的音乐声之外，船上没有任何回应。

Maybe they can't hear us over the music. Boy, music these days... they're just too loud for me...
也许他们音乐声开的太大，听不见我们说话。最近的音乐……对我来说还是太吵了……

It'll be faster if we just head over there and ask them in person.
我们直接过去问问会比较快。

<I guess we can quickly stop by and ask them a few questions.>
<好吧，那我们就过去拜访一下他们，问几个问题就回来。>

We had three hours to kill anyway. Might as well make ourselves useful and collect some intel.
反正我们无论如何都要等上三个小时，我觉得还是行动起来收集信息比较好。

Ishmael shot a glance at Vergilius before staring at the floor wordlessly.
以实玛利瞥了一眼维吉里乌斯的方向，然后无言地低头盯着地板。

... I'd say it's a reckless idea to just row up to a random vessel we don't know anything about, like its owner or its history, but if the Executive Manager insists...
……我认为，在不知道那艘船是谁的，其上又发生了什么的情况下就登上去，是非常鲁莽的行为，但那若是执行经理的想法的话……

Sure. Let's 'stop by'.
好啊，就让我们去“拜访一下”吧。

Now that was a very Outis thing to say, innit?
那家伙是不是抢了奥提斯的台词？

... It's just the attitude I decided to adopt.
……我只是决定要这样做而已。

Now, this boat will come in useful.
这艘小船，现在终于派上了用场。
dataList.place:
Mephistopheles' Skiff
梅菲斯托费勒斯 小船

dataList.content:
Will this boat... not capsize?
这艘小船……会翻吗？

Should I pack some life vests or a buoy?
我们不用带些救生衣或救生圈吗？

By the time all 13 of us squeezed our way in, the skiff was absolutely packed and precariously swaying. Some Sinners' faces darkened with concern.
在我们13个人全部上船之后，狭小的小船开始不稳定地摇晃。好几名罪人的脸上都蒙上了一层阴霾。

<Don't worry, guys. Even if you all drown, I'll bring you guys right back. All right as rain.>
<不过有我在，你们不用担心吧？>

<J-just kidding...>
<只、只是开玩笑……>

Right, then. Drink responsibly, everyone.
好，各位，别喝太多，也别晚归啊。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles's Deck
梅菲斯托费勒斯 甲板

dataList.content:
In a manner that was extremely out of character, Vergilius waved at us. ... Does he know something that we don't?
维吉里乌斯非常不像他地那般挥了挥手。难不成他知道些什么？
